steps.text: A little after nine, outside the bar...

steps.title: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
messages: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.

steps.text: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
You were managing to make yourself heard
Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
You didn't seem to mind
You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
Yes, I did
There we go
Don't make me regret saying it
Too late, I'm keeping that one
Obviously
Your stop is down here
I know where it is
The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
We'll know for next time
You're already deciding there's a next time?
I'm saying I'd take you out again
You could leave a little room for uncertainty
Why? I know what I want
That must be nice
You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
No, I wasn't
They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
You really don't keep anything to yourself
Not that
Don't get ahead of yourself
Then stop looking at my mouth
I don't
I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
No, you've made that very clear
For once, can you stop looking so smug?
You're making that difficult

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.

steps.text: Don't say it
Say what?
Whatever smug thing you're about to say
I was going to say I had a good evening
Somehow you still made that sound smug
You'll get used to it
Don't push your luck
Worth a try
I need to go now
Your bus isn't here yet
I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
All right. See you tomorrow
At work
That's where I'll be
Good night
Good night, {{name:lena}}
A little later, on the bus home...
I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
Did you get a seat?
Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
The book will be relieved
It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
Was it a long walk to the stop?
No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
Okay
I'll text you when I'm inside
All right
Once she is home...
Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
Yeah, I'm still here
Sorry we stayed later than I expected
You had a good time?
Yeah, I did
The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
What sort of music?
Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
You do that?
A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
Sure you do
The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
Your manager picked it?
Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
Sounds like he's the same outside work then
He definitely likes getting his own way
And you?
I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
Big achievement
I'm choosing to count it 😌
You sound like you enjoyed yourself
I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
I'm glad you're home
Me too ❤️
Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
Okay
A few minutes later...
There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
That looks more comfortable
Much. The bag can wait until morning
At least take the lunch box out
You sound like me
Someone has to
Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
That's how it gets you
I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
Please tell me you threw some of it away
Most of it
Most?
There might be a sudden fork emergency
I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
It's actually nice having it sorted though
Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
You'll be impressed
I was going to ask about that
My collection of forks?
Coming over, idiot ❤️
I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
Can I come over after work? Around six?
Yeah, of course
You don't have somewhere else to be?
No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
I'd like that too
We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
A much more dangerous assignment
I'll bring protective equipment 😭
I missed having you here
I missed it too
And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
That can be arranged
Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
I'll be here
You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
I'll make room on the sofa
Don't take the good cushion
Still making demands from your own house
Always ❤️
Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
Did you take the lunch box out?
Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
I'll consider it
Good night handsome, love you ❤️
Love you too, see you tomorrow
See you tomorrow ❤️
